games.name: [UPDATE 6.0] Demonfall
games.desc:
Demonfall is based on the popular series Demon Slayer.

Ascend the hill with the power of humanity on your shoulder, and fight for survival along with your comrades; or head down the ravine to lose ones humanity, and live as a demon with unholy powers.
Fight, explore, learn, grow, eat, all common necessities and virtues of one, despite your path, in this world, its the survival of the fittest.

[Controls]
R - Unsheathe Sword
Tab - Menu Toggle Tab --> Configuration = Reset
M - Meditate [Skill Tree]
H - Toggle Emotes
Sprint + M1 - Lunge
Block + M1 - Shoulder Bash
C - Rush
G - Breathe
Q - Dash
F - Block
J - Mark
U - Call Crow

games.name: 🎃 MEDIEVAL STRATEGY
games.desc:
⚔️ Compete for treasure to upgrade your kingdom! Recruit armies, defend your lands, and launch strategic attacks to conquer every opponent.

🎮 Game Controls & Basics:
- Choose a game mode and you’ll spawn at your castle.
- Right-click or tap on your castle and recruit a couple of builders.
- Click on a builder to select it and move them to a nearby farm.
- Build a Windmill near the farm to generate income.
- After building 3+ Windmills, build army structures (Barracks, Siege Workshop) and recruit units.
- Units auto-attack enemies. Destroy all enemy castles to win.

🏆 The game has matchmaking: level 1-5 and level 6+. "Ranked" mode unlocks after level 7
👍 Like the game to show support!
🔒 Private server owners are given access to various commands. (game pass)
